notes: Commit 78d2f08 (17:01). New planar_metrology in postprocess_nodes.py (+81). Tests: test_planar_metrology_maps_product_geometry_to_millimetres and test_planar_metrology_requires_a_four_point_reference.

title: No way to mark the calibrated reference plane
description: Extend the workflow ROI picker so the metrology node offers Select reference plane: mark the four corners of a known rectangular conveyor area and enter its physical width and height.
notes: Commit 78d2f08 (17:01), workflow.js (+38/-?). Reuses the existing crop ROI selector, switching label and instructions on node type.

title: RealSense 3D Metrology accepted sources it cannot measure
description: Require an explicit RealSense depth source; reject Basler, RGB-only, uploaded and combined sources. Depth intrinsics come from the active RealSense runtime or can be entered manually.
notes: Commit 78d2f08 (17:01), inference_nodes.py (+24). Tests: test_realsense_metrology_rejects_non_depth_camera_sources and test_realsense_metrology_rejects_depth_source_without_realsense_runtime.

title: Export node could not choose where output lands
description: Give the Export node an Output directory that accepts a typed path or the Image Archive Browse dialog, including drive navigation and New folder. The chosen folder receives the CSV/JSON metrics and the optional annotated JPEG.
notes: Commit 78d2f08 (17:01), result_nodes.py and workflow.js, with app.py and workflow_routes.py adjusted.

title: New metrology and export behaviour undocumented
description: Document Planar World Metrology, the RealSense 3D Metrology source rules and the Export output directory in Workflow.md and the in-app documentation view.
notes: Commit 78d2f08 (17:01). Workflow.md (+20) and ui/docs/content.html (+3), including the node table row for Planar World Metrology.

title: Tablet and touch-friendly workflow UI
description: Improved tablet layouts, touch targets, node dragging, connector interaction, responsive shell behavior, and workflow documentation for coarse-pointer devices.
notes: Implemented and committed as ad6fb7b; includes workflow, Train, shell, and documentation updates

title: Pan cavity detection workflow node
description: Added a reusable cavity-detection library and Workflow node that classifies configured pan cavities as occupied or empty and exposes structured results.
notes: Implemented and committed as 9c95489; includes detector and workflow-node tests

title: Pan cavity auto-detection and optimization
description: Added automatic cavity-layout detection, workflow API support, UI action, improved detector logic, result handling, tests, and documentation.

notes: Implemented and committed as 8f83217; structured specification-driven development support

title: Experimental synthetic-data feature

notes: Experimental and rollback-ready; committed as 5ebe7b4

title: Project-aware AI Agent page

title: Distinct Agent navigation icon

title: Collapsible Settings groups

title: Descriptions for every setting
